as_told.title: Weinstein speculates the Simons Foundation hides a secret physics program

plain: The researcher Eric Weinstein suspects that Renaissance Technologies, a Long Island firm tied to Jim Simons, quietly houses a secret physics programme that employs top differential geometers, mathematicians of curved space, which is the mathematics of gravity. Michels relays that Weinstein speculated about this on the podcaster Joe Rogan's show, and Weinstein tells Michels himself that it is "one black hole that you go into and you don't come out of," the only place he can find that "hires in these exact specialties," and that "if there is a secret program, I'm pretty sure it's Renaissance Technologies," a kind of "Manhattan 3.0" on gravity and UAPs, the government's term for UFOs, placed near Brookhaven and Stony Brook and crediting the physicist C. N. Yang. Michels later frames it as the possible theoretical physics wing of the UFO legacy programme, the alleged secret effort to study recovered craft.
